name: Smith Machine Decline Bench Press
steps: Set a decline bench so the bar tracks over your lower chest, secure your legs under the pads and lie back.
Set your shoulders against the bench, take an overhand grip just outside shoulder width and release the hooks.
Lower the bar smoothly down to your lower chest with your elbows angled roughly 45 degrees from your torso.
Press the bar straight back up to full arm extension, and lock the hooks securely when finished.
tips: Double-check the bench alignment with an empty bar so the fixed bar path meets your lower chest comfortably.
Keep your wrists straight and avoid bouncing the bar off your rib cage.
